whatChanged: NEW: Monte dei Paschi's board approves an all-share exchange offer for Banco BPM worth EUR25.3bn at 1.567 MPS shares per BPM share -- the larger leg of a EUR34bn counter-offensive built to make Siena too big for Intesa Sanpaolo's ~EUR30.5bn bid to swallow (bmps-bpm-exchange-offer)

NEW: Monte dei Paschi simultaneously bids EUR8.72bn for Banca Generali at 6.958 MPS shares apiece -- an implied EUR74.284 a share, ~10% premium -- with the two offers not conditionally linked, so this leg can complete even if the BPM leg fails (bmps-banca-generali-exchange-offer)

NEW: Broadcom is reported in talks with lenders for more than $60bn -- potentially $70-80bn -- to fund an SPV that buys its own custom AI chips and leases them to Anthropic and potentially OpenAI, with Broadcom guaranteeing part of the senior tranche (avgo-anthropic-chip-financing)

NEW: Arbutus will tender for up to $230m of its own stock at $5.00-$5.75 in a modified Dutch auction opening 24 August, recycling the ~$178m Moderna settlement proceeds and covering roughly a fifth of the company (abus-dutch-auction-tender-2026)

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: Sponsor-, sovereign-, cooperative- and strategic-led buyouts keep pulling listed names off public markets, and the pipeline is filling at both ends of the size range. Unresolved at the top end: Silver Lake is in talks to take Workday private at a ~$43bn market value (wday-silverlake-takeover-talks) and KKR has an unsolicited ~$9bn, $42.50-a-share approach on the table for utility group UGI (ugi-kkr-takeover-bid). Below that, CVC and Veritas Capital are running competing GBP1.56bn proposals for Bodycote to a 2 September deadline (boy-cvc-takeover-bid, boy-veritas-takeover-bid), Madrid-listed Deoleo has drawn rival cash offers from Dcoop at EUR470m and Coricelli at EUR500m with both controlling holders studying an exit (ole-dcoop-takeover-bid, ole-coricelli-takeover-bid), Pacific Equity Partners' SG Fleet vehicle bids A$3.60 a share for FleetPartners (fpr-sgfleet-takeover-bid), Trian is assembling co-investors behind a take-private of Wendy's (wen-trian-takeover-bid), InMode's special committee is free to act again now that the Haifa court has thrown out Steel Partners' injunction request (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), and ADW Capital's $18-a-share proposal for Driven Brands was dismissed as lacking a credible basis (drvn-adw-capital-takeover-bid). One approach has now gone over the board's head entirely: Curaleaf has formally commenced a hostile tender for Aurora Cannabis running to December 1 (acb-curaleaf-takeover-bid). Already signed or closed: Francisco Partners' $650m deal for Weave Communications at less than half its IPO valuation (weav-francisco-partners-take-private), Thoma Bravo's $4bn+ deal for Accelerant barely a year after its NYSE listing (arx-thoma-bravo-take-private), Bernhard Capital's $43-a-share deal for engineering consultancy Bowman (bwmn-bernhard-capital-takeover), Blackstone Infrastructure's Safe Harbor buying MarineMax at $53 a share (hzo-safe-harbor-acquisition), Nielsen's $13.60-a-share deal for DoubleVerify (dv-nielsen-acquisition), Apollo's firm 715p easyJet offer (ezj-apollo-takeover), KKR's $127-a-share agreement for Integer Holdings (itgr-kkr-takeover) and the completed $55bn PIF-Silver Lake-Affinity buyout of EA (ea-pif-consortium-take-private).

themes.label: UK-listed franchises broken up or taken private
themes.note: The London market keeps losing control of its own constituents to overseas and private capital, from the FTSE 100 down into the FTSE 250's industrials. Bodycote, the largest independent thermal-processing network in the West, has twin cash approaches a penny apart -- CVC at up to 915p (boy-cvc-takeover-bid) and Veritas Capital at up to 914p (boy-veritas-takeover-bid) -- with the board running both through confirmatory due diligence ahead of the 2 September Rule 2.6 deadline and neither yet firmed up with under a fortnight to run. Above them, Apollo's 715p-a-share, GBP5.7bn cash offer for easyJet is firm and board-recommended after Castlelake walked away (ezj-apollo-takeover), and Prologis has a recommended Rule 2.7 offer valuing Segro at ~GBP14.3bn that would remove one of the FTSE 100's largest REITs from the LSE (pld-sgro-takeover-bid).

themes.label: AI data-center capacity and power build-out
themes.note: Capital keeps pouring into the physical layer of AI compute, and the constraint has narrowed to energised power rather than plans for it -- which is now pulling in the regulated utilities themselves: KKR's unsolicited ~$9bn approach for UGI's gas and electric utility, midstream and propane franchise is explicitly framed against data-center load growth (ugi-kkr-takeover-bid). The Ohio megaproject remains the clearest single example: Nvidia's backstop for OpenAI's PORTS-Pike campus is firm at up to $105bn of credit for the first 4.25GW, with an option covering a further 3.75GW (nvda-openai-datacenter-backstop), and Nvidia has separately put $1.5bn of equity into developer SB Energy, which with SoftBank plans at least 10GW of new generation, a 9.2GW on-site gas plant costing ~$33bn and $4.2bn of Ohio grid investment (nvda-sbenergy-investment). Elsewhere Core Scientific paid ~$444m to take ~440MW of in-service, grid-connected Oklahoma capacity off a rival miner and push its Muskogee campus toward 1.5GW of AI colocation (corz-polaris-acquisition), while Williams is paying up to $5.5bn for Momentum Midstream to connect Haynesville gas to Gulf Coast LNG and power demand (wmb-momentum-midstream-acquisition). How the build gets funded is the other half of the story, and the debt stacks keep getting larger: Nvidia has signed MOUs with six of the largest private-capital pools to mobilise over $500bn of third-party financing (nvda-compute-financing-platforms), Broadcom is now sounding lenders for more than $60bn -- potentially $70-80bn -- against a chip-leasing vehicle aimed at over 20GW of frontier-lab compute by 2028 (avgo-anthropic-chip-financing), and Intel is selling $15bn of new stock to fund fab capex (intc-equity-offering-2026). On the equipment side Madison Air is paying $5.4bn for ebm-papst's fans and motor systems partly for the data-center cooling opportunity (mair-ebmpapst-acquisition) and Prysmian pays ~$3.8bn for Atkore's conduit and cable-management business (atkr-prysmian-acquisition); at the silicon layer Marvell has locked Google into a multi-year custom-chip programme for the TPU ecosystem (mrvl-google-tpu-partnership), Sony and TSMC are putting JPY747bn into a Kumamoto image-sensor fab (sony-tsmc-image-sensor-jv), Nvidia will co-design orbital compute payloads with SpaceX (spcx-nvda-starmind-partnership), and Micron is committing $10bn over a decade to a Boise foundational-research hub for memory and AI (mu-research-labs-investment) while SK hynix returns a record KRW40trn of the HBM windfall to shareholders rather than adding a third leg of capacity (skhynix-buyback-cancellation-2026).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Deals investors thought were settled keep being decided by courts and state regulators rather than at closing. Paramount Skydance has satisfied every regulatory condition in its Warner Bros. Discovery merger agreement, with Mexico's August 14 clearance completing 68 jurisdictions, yet it still cannot close until five days after a 12-day antitrust trial set for March 2, 2027, owing Warner holders ~$7m a day from September 30, 2026 in the meantime (psky-wbd-acquisition). Delaware's Chancery Court has voided Verisk's walk-away from its $2.35bn AccuLynx purchase, ordering it to try again while the FTC review that triggered the termination is still unfinished (vrsk-acculynx-acquisition). Western Union's Intermex deal cleared New York's DFS on August 14 only for California's DFPI to suspend its own approval extension the day before (imxi-westernunion-acquisition). Two roadblocks have now come down: the Haifa court denied Steel Partners' injunction request in its entirety, releasing InMode's special committee to rule on the competing buyout bids (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), and California's PUC signed off on Charter-Cox as the final clearance needed, letting a $34.5bn merger close fifteen months after it was struck (chtr-cox-acquisition).

themes.label: Chipmakers funding or locking in the customers that buy their chips
themes.note: Vendor financing, equity and exclusivity remain the standard shape of frontier-AI deals, and the entanglement now runs in both directions. Nvidia's OpenAI backstop is a firm commitment of up to $105bn against the first 4.25GW of the Ohio campus rather than an open-ended guarantee over the whole 10GW project (nvda-openai-datacenter-backstop), and alongside it Nvidia has taken a $1.5bn equity stake in campus developer SB Energy that makes it the sole supplier of compute on the site it is financing (nvda-sbenergy-investment) -- the circularity critics object to, written into the cap table. Broadcom has now taken the same trade further than anyone: it is seeking more than $60bn of debt for a vehicle that buys Broadcom's own custom chips and leases them to Anthropic and potentially OpenAI, with Broadcom guaranteeing part of the senior tranche, so it would be booking chip revenue against paper it stands behind itself (avgo-anthropic-chip-financing). The syndicated version keeps scaling too: the six-firm compute-financing platforms are designed to lend against Nvidia's own GPUs so labs, enterprises and clouds can afford to buy them, moving the credit risk to Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR rather than carrying it in-house (nvda-compute-financing-platforms). Marvell has inverted the trade, handing Google a warrant over up to $12.2bn of its own stock -- vesting only as Google buys chips -- to anchor a custom-silicon programme for the TPU ecosystem, so the customer ends up owning the supplier rather than the other way round (mrvl-google-tpu-partnership). The pure lock-in version continues alongside: SpaceX has committed exclusively to building its AI infrastructure on NVIDIA platforms, with the two co-designing orbital compute payloads (spcx-nvda-starmind-partnership).
